Gulshan Kumar and T-Series presents Bhushan Kumar's "Shri Krishna Govind Hare Murari". This song is sung by Jubin Nautiyal. The music is composed by Raaj Aashoo and lyrics are penned by Murali Agarwal. Enjoy & stay connected with us!
Here's to make your busy morning beautiful, introducing "Shri Krishna Govind Hare Murari", a peaceful tune to mend your hearts.
Shri Krishna, Govind, Hare Murari
Hey Nath Narayan, Vasudeva.......
